findings.evidence: table with 3 rows and 3 columns, no th, scope, or headers attributes present
findings.violation: A multi-row, multi-column data table has no th, scope, or headers markup associating cells with their headers.
findings.fix: Mark header cells with <th>, and set scope (or headers/id pairs) linking data cells to their header cells.

findings.violation: The page has no usable title: the title element is missing or empty.
findings.fix: Give the page a specific <title> describing its topic or purpose.

findings.violation: Heading level skips from <h2> to <h4> with no intervening level.
findings.fix: Change this heading to <h3>, or add the missing intervening heading level.

findings.location:
line 10,

element, text 'Compare plan tiers below before you switch service.'
findings.evidence: text color #808080 on background #ffffff, contrast ratio 3.95:1
findings.violation: Contrast ratio 3.95:1 is below the 4.5:1 AA minimum for normal text.
findings.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until the ratio reaches at least 4.5:1.

note: golden-02.html plants four defects across two severities. The Residential plans section steps from an h2 straight to an h4 with no intervening h3, one skip, so WCAG-1.3.1 lands at severity 2; the plan-comparison table uses plain td cells throughout with no th, scope, or headers anywhere, which is the whole-table structural failure references/WCAG.md's anchor row fixes at severity 3 regardless of count. The lead paragraph's inline color #808080 on the default white background resolves to a 3.95:1 ratio, under the 4.5:1 AA minimum but within one point of it, so WCAG-1.4.3 lands at severity 2 rather than 3. The empty title element trips WCAG-2.4.2's all-or-nothing missing-title condition at severity 3. The two severity-3 findings exceed the default zero threshold, so the gate fails.
